articles.summary: The legendary Chicago restaurant brand will bring its iconic menu items – including its beloved Char-Broiled Burgers – to Buford as it continues its Georgia expansion, marking its second restaurant in the state following the 2025 opening of its Kennesaw location OAK BROOK, Ill., Sept.
articles.title: Portillo’s Celebrates National Cheeseburger Day with Plans for a New Restaurant in Buford, Georgia
